title.zh: 确定批准第 6734 号共和国法修正案的公民投票日期，并定于 2001 年 11 月最后一个星期一举行棉兰老穆斯林自治区民选官员选举，为此修订第 9054 号共和国法
title.en: An Act Fixing the Date of the Plebiscite for the Approval of the Amendments to Republic Act No. 6734 and Setting the Date of the Regular Elections for Elective Officials of the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao on the Last Monday of November 2001, Amending for the purpose Republic Act No. 9054, entitled "An Act to Strengthen and Expand the Organic Act for the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 6734, entitled 'An Act Providing for the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao,' as Amended," and for Other Purposes

text.en: Date of the Plebiscite. - The date of the plebiscite for the approval of the amendments under Republic Act No. 9054 shall be held not later than August 15, 2001.

First Regular Election. - The first regular election for Regional Governor, Vice-Governor and Members of the Regional Legislative Assembly under Republic Act No. 9054 shall be held on November 26, 2001.

The incumbent Regional Governor, Regional Vice-Governor and Members of the Regional Legislative Assembly of the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao shall continue in office pursuant to existing laws and until their successors shall have been duly elected and qualified.
Rules and Regulations. - The Commission on Election shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations to carry the purpose of this Act.

Repealing Clause. - All laws, acts, decrees, executive orders, administive regulations or part thereof inconsistent with this Act, and Republic Act No. 9012 are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Separability Clause. - If any provision of this Act is held unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall be valid and binding.

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect upon publication in at least two (2) national newspapers of general circulation, and one (1) local newspaper of general circulation in the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.
